RekSai|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter who travels underground. Unburrowed: Queen's Wrath (Q) empowers her attacks and Furious Bite (E) deals true damage at full Fury. Burrowed: Prey Seeker (Q) pokes from range and reveals, Tunnel (E) creates reusable tunnels, and Un-burrow (W) brings her out of the ground, knocking up enemies above her. Void Rush (R) dashes onto a marked target to execute it. While burrowed, she senses enemies moving around her.
RekSai|jgl.playstyle: Early-game jungler built for ganks and duels. Rek'Sai ganks very early thanks to her tunnels and knock-up, and wins most early duels.
RekSai|jgl.early_game: Clear fast, alternating between surface and underground (you heal while burrowed). Gank from level 3: Tunnel to arrive, Un-burrow to knock up, then Q and E on the surface. Invade when your laners have priority.
RekSai|jgl.level_2: Burrow / Un-burrow (W). You go underground (faster, you sense enemies) and come out knocking up enemies above you: first gank possible at level 2.
RekSai|jgl.level_3: Furious Bite / Tunnel (E). Full gank: Tunnel → Un-burrow → Q → Furious Bite at full Fury (true damage).
RekSai|jgl.level_6: Void Rush: dashes onto a target marked by your damage to execute it. Use it to finish a fleeing target; you're untargetable during the dash.
power_spikes: First completed item: strong duels and skirmishes.
Mid game: constant pressure thanks to your tunnels.
RekSai|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear, early ganks and invades. Create tunnels toward the lanes you're going to gank and toward objectives: they make your rotations very fast. Control Scuttles, Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. While burrowed, you sense enemies moving near you: use it to track the enemy jungler.
RekSai|jgl.trading: Ganking: Tunnel → Un-burrow → Q → E. Dueling: Un-burrow under the target, then Q and Furious Bite at full Fury, R to finish. Give up on it against champions who lock you down (Zyra).
threats: Zyra, the only clearly unfavorable matchup according to the data.
CC that stops you from coming out.
Long games where your impact drops.
mistakes: Un-burrowing with no target above you (wasted knock-up).
Forgetting to create tunnels for your rotations.
Using Furious Bite before reaching full Fury.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: You beat him in early duels: invade him.
matchup_notes.Graves: Knock him up with Un-burrow when he dashes.
matchup_notes.Zyra: Her plants and roots lock you down: don't dive her alone.

RekSai|jgl.mid_game: Constant pressure thanks to your tunnels, ganks and objectives.
RekSai|jgl.late_game: Engage with Un-burrow and execute with R. Keep tunnels near objectives.
RekSai|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler and take objectives.
RekSai|jgl.behind: Look for picks with your tunnels and play with your team.
RekSai|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to impose early pressure through ganks and tunnels, then turn your lead into objectives.
RekSai|jgl.final_tip: Create tunnels toward the lanes and objectives: they make your rotations unpredictable.
